options.name: args
options.description: A list of parameters to pass to the build.

options.name: build_number
options.description: An integer which specifies a build of a job. Is required to remove a build from the queue.

options.name: detach
options.description: Enable detached mode to not wait for the build end.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Jenkins job to build.

options.name: password
options.description: Password to authenticate with the Jenkins server.

options.name: state
options.description: Attribute that specifies if the build is to be created, deleted or stopped. The V(stopped) state has been added in community.general 3.3.0.

options.name: time_between_checks
options.description: Time in seconds to wait between requests to the Jenkins server. This times must be higher than the configured quiet time for the job.

options.name: token
options.description: API token used to authenticate with the Jenkins server.

options.name: user
options.description: User to authenticate with the Jenkins server.
